act_title: The Central Laws (Extension to Jammu and Kashmir) Act, 1968
title: 15th August, 1968, _vide_ notification No. G.S.R. 1482, dated 2nd July, 1968, _see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II,
text:
1. 15th August, 1968, _vide_ notification No. G.S.R. 1482, dated 2nd July, 1968, _see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II,_

sec. 3(i).

. Vide notification No. S.O. 3912(E), dated 30th October, 2019, this Act is made applicable to the Union territory of Jammu and

Kashmir and the Union territory of Ladakh.

2
